pending_qa.q: What is the open rate for post-purchase tracking notifications compared to regular marketing emails?
pending_qa.r: Post-purchase tracking notifications are opened approximately 80% of the time and clicked 40% of the time, significantly outperforming regular newsletters, making them a valuable channel for brand communication and strategic upselling opportunities.

pending_qa.q: How should e-commerce retailers approach delivery time expectations during peak seasons like Black Friday and Christmas?
pending_qa.r: During Black Friday and Cyber Monday, merchants can communicate longer delivery times transparently since customers expect delays due to volume and discount context; however, Christmas cutoff dates are critical and must be accurately communicated at checkout, as missing these EDDs will result in customer dissatisfaction and potential returns.
